Regarding the performance of the reporting segments, the company cites the effects of cost reductions in Japan and East Asia, the effects of increases in various costs in Europe and South Asia and Oceania, and the effects of rate revisions in Japan and Security Transport. entries.a173c5dcfd704333: It is a pure holding company established on January 4, 2022 through a sole share transfer making Nippon Express Co., Ltd. a wholly owned subsidiary through the share transfer, and it manages the operations of group companies and performs work incidental or related to that management. Its head office is at 2 Kanda Izumi-cho, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. Nippon Express Co., Ltd. is a [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiary]] with a voting rights holding ratio of 100.0% (as of December 31, 2025). The business consists mainly of the "Logistics Business," which performs, in Japan and overseas, freight motor transport, railway forwarding, air forwarding, ocean transport, port transport, warehousing and other operations (Nippon Express Co., Ltd. and 275 companies including NX America, Inc.), together with the specialized businesses "Security Transport Business" (NX Cash Logistics Corporation) and "Heavy Haulage and Construction Business" (NX Engineering Co., Ltd. and 2 other companies), and the "Logistics Support Business," including sales and real estate businesses (42 companies including NX Shoji Co., Ltd.). The [[term:segment|reporting segments]] are 8 in total: the Logistics Business divided into 5, Japan, the Americas, Europe, East Asia, and South Asia and Oceania, plus Security Transport, Heavy Haulage and Construction, and Logistics Support. The consolidated accounting standards are [[term:ifrs|IFRS Accounting Standards]], the fiscal year ends in December, and consolidated employees were 77,925 in the fiscal year ended December 2025 (in addition, the average number of temporary employees was 8,226).
